set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F04
Accountable role (person not assigned): Backend/integration engineer with identity administrator

Outcome: One institutional identity provider authenticates stable principals with a usable and revocable browser session.

Acceptance:
- Use verified provider subject bindings; cover approved external collaborators, account disablement/recovery, expiry and logout without email-only identity merging.
- Define session storage/transport, origin and request protections, secret rotation and current authorization; retain explicit service credentials rather than conferring arbitrary caller identity.
- Qualify provider errors, invalid/stale sessions and contract behavior in automated fixtures; retain a selected-provider staging rehearsal before beta qualification. Missing real provider access stays an explicit open gate.

Evidence anchors:
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/Authentication.scala
- docs/http-api.md

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: F04: Implement institutional sign-in and browser-session lifecycle
